changes: Added Makefile default WITH_LIBZIP=no and passed it to build-image.
Harness requires explicit identical web feature args and records their effective map and SHA-256.
php-version schedules an excluded other-version prime before every measured target and records ordered pair/cache-state metadata.
link-input-change accepts one sample per immutable variant, requires a variant ID, primes the unchanged parent, and records the pair.
Failed prime records are retained and suppress a successful summary/median.
Linked-input protocol now verifies that only php_wasm.c changed under the configured build-input directory, and records its parent/target blob IDs and stable patch ID.
Link-input validation checks all changes under the build-assets input tree and records the exact php_wasm.c blob pair plus stable patch ID.
